meta.title: Lint:C
meta.author: Teo (Digital Dynamite)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Lint:C by Digital Dynamite (2019-09-14). A 64K intro that won the 64K intro competition at Function 2019. Music credited to Teo on Demozoo. 144 BPM, 2:41, 19 tracks, 2917 notes. Instruments: 2 Falcon (FM synth), 6 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 3 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler). Effects: 4 Scissor, 3 Smasher, 4 Chamber. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.18 dB loudness and at most 1.07 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
